## Summary

The root cause of the failing tests was a **corrupted Python bytecode cache file** (`tests/__pycache__/support.cpython-310.pyc`). The file was only 50 bytes when it should have been around 2000 bytes, causing an `EOFError: marshal data too short` when Python tried to load the module.

The fix was simple: **delete the corrupted bytecode cache file** so Python can regenerate it from the source file on the next import. After removing the corrupted `support.cpython-310.pyc` file, all 42 tests in `tests/test_util.py` now pass successfully.
